title: India VIX snapshot (vix-snapshot/1)
description: Live India VIX reading published by algo_scalper_api (the VIX authority: it holds the INDIA_VIX websocket subscription and the VixGate state machine). The agent consumes this over `GET /api/market/vix` (dashboard token) as an advisory input to its own sizing/entry rules - share data, not decisions: Rails publishes the reading and its gate state; each consumer applies its own policy.

change_pct.description: Change vs previous close, in percent.

source.description: dhan_ws = live websocket tick; dhan_rest = REST fallback; cache = served from tick cache.

entry_ceiling.description: Rails VixGate blocks ITS OWN new entries above this (default 20.0). Advisory for the agent.

force_exit_above.description: Rails VixGate force-exits ITS OWN positions above this (default 22.0). Advisory for the agent.

state.description: Rails' own gate state, published for observability. The agent maps it to its own policy.
